title: Static Raised Wall Grab Rail
description: One original complete static public sanitary-facility grab-rail appearance, shown in a fixed partially raised pose. A thick wall anchor plate, paired pivot cheeks, one rigid root block and transverse capped pin carry a newly authored continuous upper-and-return tubular rail with a rounded nose and genuinely open central space. Opaque fastener appearances only. No sports apparatus, chair or awning mesh imported. The anchor plate lower edge defines Z=0; no ground-supported or installed-height claim and no host wall. No rotation, locking, human assistance, fall prevention, accessibility compliance, grip suitability, body fit, load capacity, installation instructions or safety certification is represented.
